description: A white T‑shirt lies crumpled on a wooden table against plain white walls. The left hand reaches forward to pinch the lower edge of the shirt while the right hand moves in to grab the opposite edge, making the T‑shirt a two-hand object as both hands lift it up, pull it outward to spread it, then bring it back down and fold it into a neater rectangle; the right hand finishes by lifting and releasing a small folded section at the end.
